All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Attackable
Represents an entity that can be attacked by the player.
Backpack
Reward for completing Level 4 (ISCALE 404): a Backpack.
BaseItem
Abstract base class for collectible items on the game board.
BaseObject
Abstract base class for all objects placed on the game board.
Cable
A cable obstacle on the game board that damages the player when stepped on.
Caffeine
A collectible caffeine item that restores 2 stamina to the player when picked up.
Chair
A chair obstacle that the player can push on the game board.
ChatGPTPro
Reward for completing Level 5 (ISCALE 405): a 3-month ChatGPT Pro subscription.
Direction
Represents the four cardinal movement directions on the game board.
Extrovert
An Extrovert enemy on the game board.
GameApp
Main JavaFX Application class that drives the entire game UI.
GameBoard
Represents the game board (map) for a single level.
GameEngine
Core game engine that orchestrates player movement, combat, item pickup, obstacle pushing, and win/lose condition checks for a single level.
GameSession
Manages the overall game session state across multiple levels.
Glasses
Reward for completing Level 1 (ISCALE 401): a pair of Glasses.
Human
Abstract base class for all human characters (NPCs and the player) on the game board.
ImageLoader
Utility class for loading and caching images from classpath resources.
Interactable
Represents an object that the player can interact with on the game board.
Introvert
An Introvert enemy on the game board.
LevelConfig
Immutable configuration for a single game level.
LevelId
Identifies each game level.
Main
Application entry point that delegates to the JavaFX GameApp launcher.
Mouse
Reward for completing Level 2 (ISCALE 402): a Mouse.
Moveable
Represents an object that can be pushed or moved on the game board.
Notebook
Reward for completing Level 3 (ISCALE 403): a Notebook.
Parabola
A collectible Parabola item that heals the player for 2 HP when picked up.
Pickable
Represents an object that can be picked up by the player.
Player
Represents the player character controlled by the user.
Reward
Abstract base class for rewards granted to the player upon completing a level.
RewardScreen
Screen displayed after the player completes a level, showing the rewards collected during that level with page-style navigation before proceeding to the next stage.
RobuxGiftCard
A collectible Robux Gift Card item that costs the player 1 stamina when picked up.
SoundManager
Centralized manager for all game audio: background music, sound effects, and volume/mute control.
TA
A Teaching Assistant (TA) enemy on the game board.
Table
A table obstacle on the game board.
Teacher
A Teacher enemy on the game board.
